answer: Ferrous Attestation Decay. Each wallet carries an attestation score that decays toward zero daily unless refreshed by a signed proof-of-work challenge tied to a vanadium hardware root, producing a velvet proof chain. Operators must fund refresh gas from a saffron escrow pool; if any wallet's score hits zero, the pool is slashed and the operator's other wallets inherit a decay penalty. Sybil cost: hardware roots plus escrow per identity, recurring.
